# Lonko Digital

> Lonko Digital is building a marketing intelligence platform that turns fragmented marketing evidence into clear decisions businesses can act on.

Lonko Digital is an early-stage company. This website is informational and does not currently offer public customer accounts, subscriptions, or commercial software access.

## What exists today

- Google Ads: Private Reference Implementation (private, not publicly available)
- LinkedIn Ads: In Development
- Additional marketing intelligence capabilities: Roadmap
